people.name: Palal
people.line: Son of Uzai, repaired Jerusalem's wall

people.name: Parosh
people.line: A man involved in repairing Jerusalem's wall

people.name: Pedaiah
people.line: Father of a man who repaired Jerusalem's wall

people.name: Uzai
people.line: Father of Palal, who repaired Jerusalem's wall

translations.web: Palal the son of Uzai made repairs opposite the turning of the wall, and the tower that stands out from the upper house of the king, which is by the court of the guard. After him Pedaiah the son of Parosh made repairs.
translations.bsb: and Palal son of Uzai made repairs opposite the angle and the tower that juts out from the upper palace of the king near the courtyard of the guard. Next to him, Pedaiah son of Parosh
translations.kjv: Palal the son of Uzai, over against the turning of the wall, and the tower which lieth out from the king's high house, that was by the court of the prison. After him Pedaiah the son of Parosh.
translations.asv: Palal the son of Uzai repaired over against the turning of the wall, and the tower that standeth out from the upper house of the king, which is by the court of the guard. After him Pedaiah the son of Parosh repaired.
